questions.question: What is the best reason to use methods?
options: To make the code shorter in terms of lines
To reuse code and separate responsibilities
explanations: A method can make the code longer overall, but more organized.
Correct. Methods let you reuse logic (write once, use many times) and separate responsibilities (each method does one specific thing).
The compiler optimizes regardless of whether you use methods.
Methods work with variables; they do not replace them.
